cta.title: Get Your ACGME Compliant Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: ACGME compliant scheduling software is a tool or service that generates residency and fellowship schedules while building the ACGME duty hour requirements in, including the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest periods, and the 24-hour cap on continuous scheduled work. Scheduling Wizard goes further by building the subspecialty requirements you tell us apply into the schedule itself, so the requirements shape the schedule rather than being checked for afterwards.
faq.question: What is ACGME compliant scheduling software?

faq.answer: You tell us which subspecialty requirements apply and we write them down with you before the first build. Every rotation, call shift and clinic assignment is then built to those rules at once. The review afterwards is a check, not a repair job.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle ACGME rules when the schedule is built for subspecialties?

faq.answer: You do, and we build to what you tell us. Before the first build we write down the requirements that apply to your program, the Common Program Requirements and anything your Review Committee adds, alongside your own rules. When the ACGME changes something, you tell us what changed and we rebuild to it. The February 2026 interim revision changed no hour limits.
faq.question: Who keeps the ACGME rules current, you or us?

faq.answer: No. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule building, while the platform you already use handles day-to-day schedule viewing and access. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have alongside the service. Scheduling Wizard delivers finished schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, which programs can upload directly to their existing viewing platform.
faq.question: Do I need to replace the platform we use now to use Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard works with chief residents, program directors, program coordinators, and GME offices. Chief residents and coordinators typically submit rules and review delivered schedules. Program directors and GME offices benefit from the institutional continuity the service provides, ensuring that ACGME compliance knowledge and scheduling rules persist across annual chief rotations rather than being lost when leadership changes.
faq.question: Who at a residency program typically works with Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard produces block or rotation schedules, Call schedules with fair call distribution, Clinic schedules, and Attending schedules. All four schedule types are built together, so that changes in one propagate correctly across the others. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you ready for upload to the program's existing schedule publishing platform.

searchIntents: As a residency program director, I'm looking for a reliable scheduling solution that ensures compliance with ACGME rules to avoid penalties or surface at review for accreditation for our medical residency program.

I'm a chief resident trying to minimize the scheduling burden on myself and my colleagues. We need a managed service that enforces ACGME rules when the schedule is built without forcing us to learn new software or deal with complex scheduling tasks.

As a program coordinator, I need an efficient way to create schedules built to the ACGME requirements for multiple departments, but I want to ensure that they're finished for fairness and resident preferences, without dealing with the technical details myself.

Working in a GME office, I’m searching for software that not only meets ACGME compliance but also handles the unique scheduling requirements of our subspecialties to ensure we remain competitive and can adequately train our residents.
